description: Create a new API key on this account and return it once. The new key can never be broader than the key making the call: same or fewer capabilities, the same source-IP limit, no later expiry, no higher per-minute limit, only account read scopes this key has, and never any write scope. At most 20 keys per account per UTC day this way. Needs the keys:write account scope, which is off by default and can only be granted by the account owner in the console.

scope_mode.description: Omit to copy this key's own capability scope

name: everyinfra_key_create
title: Create an API key
